##################################################
# CZECH GRAMMAR ENGINE - MACROS
# By Crafter and Phantomiux
##################################################
#
# Production macro layer for Czech localization.
# Keep entity/scope dispatch in custom localization;
# keep reusable string and morphology logic here.
#
# '# cost: N' above each macro = static cost in evaluated data-binding
# nodes (Select_CString evaluates all branches, Custom()/Localize() only the
# resolved key, each argument counted as 1; 'worst / mean' over dispatch
# targets). Relative only. Generated by scripts/ck3_grammar/annotate_costs.py,
# rerun after changing macros.
#
# Naming:
#   G = Genitive, D = Dative, A = Accusative
#   V = Vocative, L = Locative, I = Instrumental
#   M = Male, F = Female
##################################################

##################################################
# GENERIC STRING PRIMITIVES
##################################################

# ------------------------------------------------
# JOIN
# ------------------------------------------------

# cost: 12
macro = {
	description = "Join two non-empty strings with one space"
	definition = "CZJoin(A,B)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(StringIsEmpty(A),B,Select_CString(StringIsEmpty(B),A,Concatenate(A,Concatenate(' ',B))))"
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# CHARACTER NAME PREFIX
# ------------------------------------------------

# Exact reconstruction is intentional: CK3 character names may
# contain NBSP, e.g. "Král Sancho II.". The helper must not
# tokenize that prefix by ordinary spaces.

# cost: 16
macro = {
	description = "True if PREFIX is an exact CK3 character-name prefix of TEXT"
	definition = "CZHasNamePrefix(TEXT,PREFIX)"
	replace_with = "And(Not(StringIsEmpty(PREFIX)),EqualTo_string(TEXT,Concatenate(PREFIX,Select_CString(EqualTo_string(TEXT,PREFIX),'',Concatenate(' ',TrimFrontChars(TEXT,PREFIX))))))"
}

# cost: 36
macro = {
	description = "Replace an exact CK3 character-name prefix while preserving the remaining suffix"
	definition = "CZReplaceNamePrefix(TEXT,PREFIX,REPLACEMENT)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZHasNamePrefix(TEXT,PREFIX),CZJoin(REPLACEMENT,TrimFrontChars(TEXT,PREFIX)),TEXT)"
}


##################################################
# TITLE TOKENIZER
##################################################
# CZ_TitleTokenChars is defined in:
# localization/polish/custom_localization/cz_custom_loc/00_cz_custom_loc_l_polish.yml
#
# Space is intentionally NOT included in CZ_TitleTokenChars and therefore
# acts as the separator. Current supported title length: 1-3 words.

# ------------------------------------------------
# DETECTION
# ------------------------------------------------

# cost: 6
macro = {
	description = "True if TITLE contains at least two words"
	definition = "CZTitleHasSecond(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "Not(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))))"
}

# cost: 9
macro = {
	description = "True if TITLE contains at least three words"
	definition = "CZTitleHasThird(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "Not(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))))"
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# WORD EXTRACTION
# ------------------------------------------------

# cost: 27
macro = {
	description = "Return first word of a one-to-three-word TITLE"
	definition = "CZTitleWord1(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))), TITLE, Select_CString(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))), TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))))"
}

# cost: 26
macro = {
	description = "Return second word of a one-to-three-word TITLE"
	definition = "CZTitleWord2(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))), '', Select_CString(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))), TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))))"
}

# cost: 16
macro = {
	description = "Return third word of a one-to-three-word TITLE"
	definition = "CZTitleWord3(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))), '', TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))))"
}

# Exact-count word extraction. Only valid once the word count is known
# (after CZTitleWordCountKey dispatch); no Select, so cheap to repeat.

# cost: 23
macro = {
	description = "Custom() key BASE1/BASE2/BASE3 by TITLE word count (3 = three or more)"
	definition = "CZTitleWordCountKey(TITLE,BASE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZTitleHasThird(TITLE),Concatenate(BASE,'3'),Select_CString(CZTitleHasSecond(TITLE),Concatenate(BASE,'2'),Concatenate(BASE,'1')))"
}

# cost: 4
macro = {
	description = "First word of a two-word TITLE"
	definition = "CZTitleW1of2(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))"
}

# cost: 4
macro = {
	description = "Second word of a two-word TITLE"
	definition = "CZTitleW2of2(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))"
}

# cost: 7
macro = {
	description = "First word of a three-word TITLE"
	definition = "CZTitleW1of3(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))"
}

# cost: 7
macro = {
	description = "Second word of a three-word TITLE"
	definition = "CZTitleW2of3(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))"
}

# cost: 7
macro = {
	description = "Third word (rest) of a three-word TITLE"
	definition = "CZTitleW3of3(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))"
}

# Rank title table (CZ_TN_<case>_<M|F>_<w1>_<w2>[_<w3>], gen_title_rank_table.py)
# for 2-3 word ruler titles: the per-word rules cost ~440 (2 words) / ~900
# (3 words); a table hit is one Localize(). One-word titles keep the rules
# (already cheap). Dispatch: CZ_TitleAsName*_<case>_<g><n> -> _T (table) or _R (rules).

# cost: 14
macro = {
	description = "Rank table key for a two-word title"
	definition = "CZTitleRankKey2(TITLE,CG)"
	replace_with = "Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate('CZ_TN_',CG),'_'),CZTitleW1of2(TITLE)),Concatenate('_',CZTitleW2of2(TITLE)))"
}

# cost: 29
macro = {
	description = "Rank table key for a three-word title"
	definition = "CZTitleRankKey3(TITLE,CG)"
	replace_with = "Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate('CZ_TN_',CG),'_'),CZTitleW1of3(TITLE)),Concatenate('_',CZTitleW2of3(TITLE))),Concatenate('_',CZTitleW3of3(TITLE)))"
}

# cost: 9
macro = {
	description = "Custom key BASE_T if rank table key K exists, else BASE_R (rules)"
	definition = "CZTitleRankDispatch(K,BASE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(EqualTo_string(Localize(K),K),Concatenate(BASE,'_R'),Concatenate(BASE,'_T'))"
}

##################################################
# TITLE DECLENSION - WORD MORPHOLOGY
##################################################

# ------------------------------------------------
# GENITIVE
# ------------------------------------------------

# cost: 107
macro = {
	description = "Czech title word genitive (male)"
	definition = "CZTitleWord_G_M(WORD)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'ý'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'ý'),'ého'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'í'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'í'),'ího'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'a'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'a'),'y'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'o'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'o'),'a'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'ě'))),Concatenate(WORD,'te'),Select_CString(And(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'e'))),Not(EqualTo_string(TrimBackChars(WORD,'e'),TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(WORD,'e'),'ž')))),Concatenate(WORD,'te'),Select_CString(And(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'e'))),Not(EqualTo_string(TrimBackChars(WORD,'e'),TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(WORD,'e'),'c')))),WORD,Select_CString(Or(Or(EqualTo_string(WORD,'Král'),EqualTo_string(WORD,'král')),Or(EqualTo_string(WORD,'Velkokrál'),EqualTo_string(WORD,'Velekrál'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'l'),'le'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'bcčdďfghjklmnňpqrřsštťvwxzž'))),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'cčďjňřsšťxzž'))),Concatenate(WORD,'e'),Concatenate(WORD,'a')),WORD)))))))))"
}

# cost: 35
macro = {
	description = "Czech title word genitive (female)"
	definition = "CZTitleWord_G_F(WORD)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'ý'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'ý'),'ého'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'á'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'á'),'é'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'í'))),WORD,Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'a'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'a'),'y'),WORD))))"
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# DATIVE
# ------------------------------------------------

# cost: 86
macro = {
	description = "Czech title word dative (male)"
	definition = "CZTitleWord_D_M(WORD)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'ý'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'ý'),'ému'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'í'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'í'),'ímu'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'a'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'a'),'ovi'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'o'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'o'),'ovi'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'ě'))),Concatenate(WORD,'ti'),Select_CString(And(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'e'))),Not(EqualTo_string(TrimBackChars(WORD,'e'),TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(WORD,'e'),'ž')))),Concatenate(WORD,'ti'),Select_CString(And(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'e'))),Not(EqualTo_string(TrimBackChars(WORD,'e'),TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(WORD,'e'),'c')))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'e'),'i'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'bcčdďfghjklmnňpqrřsštťvwxzž'))),Concatenate(WORD,'ovi'),WORD))))))))"
}

# cost: 62
macro = {
	description = "Czech title word dative (female)"
	definition = "CZTitleWord_D_F(WORD)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'ý'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'ý'),'ému'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'á'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'á'),'é'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'í'))),WORD,Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'a'))),Select_CString(And(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'a'))),Not(EqualTo_string(TrimBackChars(WORD,'a'),TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(WORD,'a'),'k')))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(WORD,'a'),'k'),'ce'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'a'),'ě')),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'eě'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'eě'),'i'),WORD)))))"
}

# cost: 84
macro = {
	description = "Czech title word vocative (male)"
	definition = "CZTitleWord_V_M(WORD)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'ý'))),WORD,Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'í'))),WORD,Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'a'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'a'),'o'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'o'))),WORD,Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'ě'))),WORD,Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'e'))),WORD,Select_CString(Or(Or(EqualTo_string(WORD,'Král'),EqualTo_string(WORD,'král')),Or(EqualTo_string(WORD,'Velkokrál'),EqualTo_string(WORD,'Velekrál'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(WORD,'l'),'li'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'bcčdďfghjklmnňpqrřsštťvwxzž'))),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'kgh'))),Concatenate(WORD,'u'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(WORD,TrimBackChars(WORD,'cčďjňřšťž'))),Concatenate(WORD,'i'),Concatenate(WORD,'e'))),WORD))))))))"
}

}

##################################################
# TITLE DECLENSION - 1-3 WORD COMPOSERS
##################################################

# ------------------------------------------------
# GENITIVE
# ------------------------------------------------

# cost: 5956
macro = {
	description = "Czech 1-3 word title genitive (male)"
	definition = "CZTitleCase_G_M(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZTitleHasThird(TITLE),Concatenate(CZTitleWord_G_M(CZTitleWord1(TITLE)),Concatenate(' ',Concatenate(CZTitleWord_G_M(CZTitleWord2(TITLE)),Concatenate(' ',CZTitleWord_G_M(CZTitleWord3(TITLE)))))),Select_CString(CZTitleHasSecond(TITLE),Concatenate(CZTitleWord_G_M(CZTitleWord1(TITLE)),Concatenate(' ',CZTitleWord_G_M(CZTitleWord2(TITLE)))),CZTitleWord_G_M(CZTitleWord1(TITLE))))"
}

# cost: 2092
macro = {
	description = "Czech 1-3 word title genitive (female)"
	definition = "CZTitleCase_G_F(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZTitleHasThird(TITLE),Concatenate(CZTitleWord_G_F(CZTitleWord1(TITLE)),Concatenate(' ',Concatenate(CZTitleWord_G_F(CZTitleWord2(TITLE)),Concatenate(' ',CZTitleWord_G_F(CZTitleWord3(TITLE)))))),Select_CString(CZTitleHasSecond(TITLE),Concatenate(CZTitleWord_G_F(CZTitleWord1(TITLE)),Concatenate(' ',CZTitleWord_G_F(CZTitleWord2(TITLE)))),CZTitleWord_G_F(CZTitleWord1(TITLE))))"
}

# cost: 5956
macro = {
	description = "Czech 1-3 word title accusative (male)"
	definition = "CZTitleCase_A_M(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZTitleHasThird(TITLE),Concatenate(CZTitleWord_A_M(CZTitleWord1(TITLE)),Concatenate(' ',Concatenate(CZTitleWord_A_M(CZTitleWord2(TITLE)),Concatenate(' ',CZTitleWord_A_M(CZTitleWord3(TITLE)))))),Select_CString(CZTitleHasSecond(TITLE),Concatenate(CZTitleWord_A_M(CZTitleWord1(TITLE)),Concatenate(' ',CZTitleWord_A_M(CZTitleWord2(TITLE)))),CZTitleWord_A_M(CZTitleWord1(TITLE))))"
}

##################################################
# ADJECTIVE DECLENSION
##################################################
# Plain morphology is shared by Culture / Faith / Religion / Title.
#
# Rich/native presentation is intentionally asymmetric:
# - Culture and Landed Title keep explicit CustomLoc wrappers in
#   00_cz_custom_loc_l_polish.yml + 99_cz_custom_loc.txt.
# - Faith and Religion must be declined directly from their native rich
#   GetAdjective CString because their tooltip metadata cannot be rebuilt
#   reliably from CustomLoc scope data.
##################################################

# ------------------------------------------------
# PLAIN ADJECTIVE
# ------------------------------------------------

# cost: 2
macro = {
	description = "Return Czech adjective stem by removing final -ý / -á"
	definition = "CZAdjectiveStem(ADJECTIVE)"
	replace_with = "TrimBackChars(ADJECTIVE,'ýá')"
}

# cost: 4
macro = {
	description = "Replace final Czech adjective -ý / -á with ENDING"
	definition = "CZAdjectiveDecline(ADJECTIVE,ENDING)"
	replace_with = "Concatenate(CZAdjectiveStem(ADJECTIVE),ENDING)"
}

# cost: 23
macro = {
	description = "Czech adjective animate plural: -ští / -čtí / -í"
	definition = "CZAdjectiveSti(ADJECTIVE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(TrimBackChars(ADJECTIVE,'ýák'),TrimBackChars(ADJECTIVE,'ýáks'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(ADJECTIVE,'ýáks'),'ští'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(TrimBackChars(ADJECTIVE,'ýák'),TrimBackChars(ADJECTIVE,'ýákc'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(ADJECTIVE,'ýákc'),'čtí'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(ADJECTIVE,'ýá'),'í')))"
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# RICH ADJECTIVE - FAITH / RELIGION ONLY
# ------------------------------------------------
# The native getter already contains the correct object tooltip/click metadata.
# CZ_FMT_TRIM removes the adjective ending together with trailing rich-text
# closers; the wrapper then appends the requested ending and restores exactly
# the number of closers used by that native getter.

# cost: 8
macro = {
	description = "Decline a native rich adjective CString and restore its closers"
	definition = "CZAdjectiveDeclineRich(ADJECTIVE,ENDING,CLOSE)"
	replace_with = "Concatenate(Concatenate(TrimBackChars(ADJECTIVE,Localize('CZ_FMT_TRIM')),ENDING),Localize(CLOSE))"
}

# cost: 8
macro = {
	description = "Czech Faith adjective with native tooltip and onclick"
	definition = "CZFaithAdjDecline(FAITH,ENDING)"
	replace_with = "CZAdjectiveDeclineRich(FAITH.GetAdjective,ENDING,'CZ_FMT_CLOSE3')"
}

# cost: 8
macro = {
	description = "Czech Religion adjective with native tooltip"
	definition = "CZReligionAdjDecline(RELIGION,ENDING)"
	replace_with = "CZAdjectiveDeclineRich(RELIGION.GetAdjective,ENDING,'CZ_FMT_CLOSE2')"
}

# cost: 40
macro = {
	description = "Convert a native rich adjective CString to Czech animate plural and restore its closers"
	definition = "CZAdjectiveStiRich(ADJECTIVE,CLOSE)"
	replace_with = "Concatenate(CZAdjectiveSti(TrimBackChars(ADJECTIVE,Localize('CZ_FMT_CLOSE_CHARS'))),Localize(CLOSE))"
}

# cost: 46
macro = {
	description = "Czech Faith animate-plural adjective with native tooltip and onclick"
	definition = "CZFaithAdjSti(FAITH)"
	replace_with = "CZAdjectiveStiRich(FAITH.GetAdjective,'CZ_FMT_CLOSE3')"
}

# cost: 46
macro = {
	description = "Czech Religion animate-plural adjective with native tooltip"
	definition = "CZReligionAdjSti(RELIGION)"
	replace_with = "CZAdjectiveStiRich(RELIGION.GetAdjective,'CZ_FMT_CLOSE2')"
}


##################################################
# LANDED TITLE DECLENSION (PROTOTYPE)
##################################################
# Declension of landed title names (Čechy, Království Čechy, Svatá říše římská).
#
# Layers:
# 1. CZLandWord_*    - inanimate word morphology (nouns + adjectives).
#                      Intentionally separate from CZTitleWord_* which is
#                      animate (Král -> Krále) and would produce
#                      "Království -> Královstvího".
# 2. CZLandCase1/2/3_* - fixed-length composers (1, 2, 3 words).
#    CZLandCase_*    - generic 1-3 word composer for literal strings
#                      (debug); slower, evaluates every length.
# 3. Dispatch        - CZLand*Key macros pick ONE CustomLoc key
#                      (table / composer by length / unchanged / tier part),
#                      evaluated lazily via Custom(<key>). Select_CString
#                      itself is eager, so this keeps unused branches out.
#                      Table: CZ_LT_<title key>_<case> in
#                      00_cz_landed_title_cases_l_polish.yml, used only
#                      while the title carries its default name.
#                      Tiered names ("Království Čechy"): only the tier
#                      phrase is declined ("s Královstvím Čechy").
# 4. CZLandRich      - puts the declined text into the native rich getter
#                      (tooltip + onclick).
#
# Vocative is intentionally not provided for landed titles.
##################################################

# ------------------------------------------------
# HELPERS
# ------------------------------------------------

# cost: 6
macro = {
	description = "True if XW ends with any of the characters in XC"
	definition = "CZEnds(XW,XC)"
	replace_with = "Not(EqualTo_string(XW,TrimBackChars(XW,XC)))"
}

# cost: 17
macro = {
	description = "True if XW ends with a character from XC preceded by a character from XP"
	definition = "CZEnds2(XW,XC,XP)"
	replace_with = "And(CZEnds(XW,XC),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(XW,XC),XP))"
}

# cost: 12
macro = {
	description = "True if TITLE contains at least four words"
	definition = "CZTitleHasFourth(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "Not(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TITLE, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))))"
}
# cost: 112
macro = {
	description = "Dative/locative of a feminine -a stem with consonant alternation: Prah -> Praze, Litv -> Litvě, Mekk -> Mekce; soft or vowel stem -i: Akaš -> Akaši, Capu -> Capui, Turň -> Turni, Brodnic -> Brodnici (other -c stays -ce: Huesc -> Huesce)"
	definition = "CZLandSoftA(XS)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZEnds2(XS,'h','c'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XS,'h'),'c'),'še'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XS,'hg'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XS,'hg'),'ze'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XS,'k'),Concatenate(Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XS,'k'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XS,'k'),'k'),XS)),'k','')),'ce'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XS,'r'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XS,'r'),'ře'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XS,'dtnbpvfm'),Concatenate(XS,'ě'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XS,'ň'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XS,'ň'),'ni'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XS,'ť'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XS,'ť'),'ti'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XS,'ď'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XS,'ď'),'di'),Select_CString(Or(CZEnds(XS,'žšřčjaeiouyáéíóúůý'),CZEnds2(XS,'c','iy')),Concatenate(XS,'i'),Concatenate(XS,'e'))))))))))"
}
# cost: 38
macro = {
	description = "True if XW ends with a doubled vowel -aa / -oo / -ee (Harjumaa, Espoo, Dundee): left unchanged, TrimBackChars would strip both"
	definition = "CZLandDblVowel(XW)"
	replace_with = "Or(And(Not(EqualTo_string(XW,TrimBackChars(XW,'a'))),Not(EqualTo_string(XW,Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'a'),'a')))),Or(And(Not(EqualTo_string(XW,TrimBackChars(XW,'o'))),Not(EqualTo_string(XW,Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'o'),'o')))),And(Not(EqualTo_string(XW,TrimBackChars(XW,'e'))),Not(EqualTo_string(XW,Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'e'),'e'))))))"
}

# cost: 53
macro = {
	description = "True if XW starts with a lowercase Arabic article: al- el- an- as- ad- ar- at- az- aš- (al-Jamaní)"
	definition = "CZLandIsArticle(XW)"
	replace_with = "Or(EqualTo_string(Concatenate('al-',TrimFrontChars(XW,'al-')),XW),Or(EqualTo_string(Concatenate('el-',TrimFrontChars(XW,'el-')),XW),Or(EqualTo_string(Concatenate('an-',TrimFrontChars(XW,'an-')),XW),Or(EqualTo_string(Concatenate('as-',TrimFrontChars(XW,'as-')),XW),Or(EqualTo_string(Concatenate('ad-',TrimFrontChars(XW,'ad-')),XW),Or(EqualTo_string(Concatenate('ar-',TrimFrontChars(XW,'ar-')),XW),Or(EqualTo_string(Concatenate('at-',TrimFrontChars(XW,'at-')),XW),Or(EqualTo_string(Concatenate('az-',TrimFrontChars(XW,'az-')),XW),EqualTo_string(Concatenate('aš-',TrimFrontChars(XW,'aš-')),XW)))))))))"
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# WORD MORPHOLOGY
# ------------------------------------------------
# Doubled final vowel (-aa / -oo / -ee): unchanged.
# Grouped by final letter, first match wins inside a group:
#   ends in a vowel ('áýéíeěao'):
#     - fem. adj -á
#     - masc./neut. adj -ý/-é
#     - neut. noun -ví (království, knížectví)
#     - soft adj -ní/-ší/-cí/-tí (vrchní; unchanged with a feminine noun: nejjasnější republika)
#     - other -í (údolí, Dillí): unchanged
#     - neut. noun -iště (tábořiště)
#     - fem. noun -e/-ě (říše, Francie)
#     - fem. noun -ea (Galilea, Chaldea, Nicea)
#     - fem. noun -ia (Brescia, Cumbria)
#     - fem. noun -a (Praha, Litva)
#     - neut. noun -o (Polsko)
#   ends in a soft consonant ('cňťžšřčj'):
#     - masc. -ec with mobile e (Hradec, Žatec)
#     - fem. -eň with mobile e (Plzeň, Vídeň)
#     - fem. -ň (Poznaň, Bretaň, Soluň)
#     - fem. -ť (Pešť)
#     - masc. soft consonant (stroj)
#   otherwise:
#     - fem. noun -ost, only in a feminine phrase (Svatá svornost); one-word -ost is masc. (Bost -> Bostu)
#     - fem. noun -kev (církev)
#     - latin -ium/-tum/-num/-trum (Imperium, Latium, Regnum, Castrum); other -um is masc. hrad (Aksum, Erzurum)
#     - masc. -ov/-ev/-ín/-ýn (Janov, Kyjev, Berlín): gen. -a, loc. -ě
#     - masc. hard consonant (hrad)
#   no match: unchanged (-y plurals such as Čechy/Benátky, -u, -i, -ó ...)
# cost: 413
macro = {
	description = "Czech landed title word genitive; XF = phrase noun is feminine"
	definition = "CZLandWord_G(XW,XF)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZLandDblVowel(XW),XW,Select_CString(CZEnds(XW,'áýéíeěao'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XW,'á'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'á'),'é'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XW,'ýé'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'ýé'),'ého'),Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'í','v'),XW,Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'í','nšct'),Select_CString(XF,XW,Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'í'),'ího')),Select_CString(CZEnds(XW,'í'),XW,Select_CString(And(CZEnds2(XW,'ě','t'),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'ě'),'t'),'š')),XW,Select_CString(CZEnds(XW,'eě'),XW,Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'a','e'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'a'),'je'),Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'a','i'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'a'),'e'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XW,'a'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'a'),Select_CString(CZEnds(TrimBackChars(XW,'a'),'žšřčcj'),'e','y')),Select_CString(CZEnds(XW,'o'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'o'),'a'),XW))))))))))),Select_CString(CZEnds(XW,'cňťžšřčj'),Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'c','e'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'c'),'e'),'ce'),Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'ň','e'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'ň'),'e'),'ně'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XW,'ň'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'ň'),'ně'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XW,'ť'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'ť'),'ti'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XW,'žšřčcj'),Concatenate(XW,'e'),XW))))),Select_CString(And(XF,And(CZEnds2(XW,'t','s'),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'t'),'s'),'o'))),Concatenate(XW,'i'),Select_CString(And(CZEnds2(XW,'v','e'),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'v'),'e'),'k')),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'v'),'e'),'ve'),Select_CString(And(CZEnds2(XW,'m','u'),Or(CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'m'),'u'),'itn'),And(CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'m'),'u'),'r'),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'m'),'u'),'r'),'t')))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'m'),'u'),'a'),Select_CString(Or(CZEnds2(XW,'v','oe'),CZEnds2(XW,'n','íý')),Concatenate(XW,'a'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XW,'bdfghklmnpqrstvwxz'),Concatenate(XW,'u'),XW))))))))"
}
# cost: 554

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1-3 WORD COMPOSERS
# ------------------------------------------------
# Safety guard: a name is declined only if it has exactly one noun and all
# other words are adjectives (Svatá říše římská, Kyjevská Rus, Velký chrám).
# Anything else (Kara Dala, Páni nebes, Lužičtí Srbové, plurals such as
# Kanárské ostrovy) stays in nominative; plurals go to the table.

# cost: 111
macro = {
	description = "True if XW looks like an adjective: -á / -ý / -é, or soft -ní / -ší / -cí / -tí; not -telé plurals (Obdivovatelé) and not article words (al-Jamaní)"
	definition = "CZLandIsAdj(XW)"
	replace_with = "And(Not(CZLandIsArticle(XW)),Or(And(CZEnds(XW,'áýé'),Not(And(CZEnds2(XW,'é','l'),CZEnds2(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'l'),'e','t')))),CZEnds2(XW,'í','nšct')))"
}

# cost: 20
macro = {
	description = "True if XW looks like an animate plural adjective: -í except -ví nouns"
	definition = "CZLandIsAdjPl(XW)"
	replace_with = "And(CZEnds(XW,'í'),Not(CZEnds2(XW,'í','v')))"
}

# cost: 118
macro = {
	description = "True if XW is a feminine noun: not an adjective and ending in -a / -e / -ě / -ň / -ť"
	definition = "CZLandIsFemNoun(XW)"
	replace_with = "And(Not(CZLandIsAdj(XW)),CZEnds(XW,'aeěňť'))"
}

# cost: 124
macro = {
	description = "True if XW makes a phrase feminine: a feminine noun or a feminine adjective -á (Svatá svornost)"
	definition = "CZLandIsFemWord(XW)"
	replace_with = "Or(CZLandIsFemNoun(XW),CZEnds(XW,'á'))"
}

# cost: 2750
macro = {
	description = "True if any word of a 1-3 word TITLE is a feminine noun (drives soft adjective agreement)"
	definition = "CZLandIsFemPhrase(TITLE)"
	replace_with = "Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZTitleWord1(TITLE)),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZTitleWord2(TITLE)),CZLandIsFemWord(CZTitleWord3(TITLE))))"
}

# cost: 116
macro = {
	description = "True if XW is a non-empty non-adjective word"
	definition = "CZLandIsNoun(XW)"
	replace_with = "And(Not(StringIsEmpty(XW)),Not(CZLandIsAdj(XW)))"
}

# cost: 455
macro = {
	description = "True if exactly one of the (possibly empty) words XA, XB, XC is a noun and no word ends in -y / -i (plurals: Kanárské ostrovy, Vnitřní Hebridy; indeclinables) and -é is not combined with plural -í (Bílí Chorvaté)"
	definition = "CZLandOneNoun(XA,XB,XC)"
	replace_with = "EqualTo_string(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(Select_CString(CZLandIsNoun(XA),'n',''),Select_CString(CZLandIsNoun(XB),'n','')),Select_CString(CZLandIsNoun(XC),'n','')),Select_CString(Or(CZEnds(XA,'yi'),Or(CZEnds(XB,'yi'),CZEnds(XC,'yi'))),'x','')),Select_CString(And(Or(CZEnds(XA,'é'),Or(CZEnds(XB,'é'),CZEnds(XC,'é'))),Or(CZLandIsAdjPl(XA),Or(CZLandIsAdjPl(XB),CZLandIsAdjPl(XC)))),'x','')),'n')"
}
# cost: 9428
macro = {
	description = "Czech 1-3 word landed title name genitive (XFEM = feminine phrase flag)"
	definition = "CZLandCaseF_G(TITLE,XFEM)"
	replace_with = "TrimBack(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(CZLandWord_G(CZTitleWord1(TITLE),XFEM),' '),CZLandWord_G(CZTitleWord2(TITLE),XFEM)),Concatenate(' ',CZLandWord_G(CZTitleWord3(TITLE),XFEM))))"
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# FIXED-LENGTH WORD EXTRACTION
# ------------------------------------------------
# Cheaper than CZTitleWord1-3 when the word count is already known
# (used inside the 2- and 3-word dispatch branches).

# cost: 4
macro = {
	description = "First word of an exactly two-word N"
	definition = "CZLandW2a(N)"
	replace_with = "TrimBack(TrimBackChars(N,Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))"
}

# cost: 4
macro = {
	description = "Second word of an exactly two-word N"
	definition = "CZLandW2b(N)"
	replace_with = "TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(N,Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))"
}

# cost: 7
macro = {
	description = "First word of an exactly three-word N"
	definition = "CZLandW3a(N)"
	replace_with = "TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(N,Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))),Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))"
}

# cost: 7
macro = {
	description = "Second word of an exactly three-word N"
	definition = "CZLandW3b(N)"
	replace_with = "TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(N,Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))),Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))"
}

# cost: 7
macro = {
	description = "Third word of an exactly three-word N"
	definition = "CZLandW3c(N)"
	replace_with = "TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(N,Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))),Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))"
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# ANIMATE PLURALS (one-word tribal names)
# ------------------------------------------------
# Tribal / nomadic titles are often named after a people:
# Oghuzové, Pečeněhové, Polané, Kozáci, Estonci, Kumáni. Handled only for one-word
# names: in phrases -ové is usually an adjective (Kmenové království).

# cost: 85
macro = {
	description = "True if XW is a one-word animate plural: -ové, -ané, -ci, long vowel + -ni (Kumáni; not Trapani)"
	definition = "CZLandIsAnimPl(XW)"
	replace_with = "Or(And(CZEnds2(XW,'é','v'),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'v'),'o')),Or(And(CZEnds2(XW,'é','n'),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'n'),'a')),Or(CZEnds2(XW,'i','c'),And(CZEnds2(XW,'i','n'),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'i'),'n'),'áéíóúý')))))"
}

# cost: 4
macro = {
	description = "Stem of an -ové plural: Oghuzové -> Oghuz"
	definition = "CZLandStemOve(XW)"
	replace_with = "TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'v'),'o')"
}

# cost: 16
macro = {
	description = "Stem of a -ci plural with k-alternation (Kozáci, Turci -> Kozák, Turk); otherwise the -c stem (Estonci -> Estonc)"
	definition = "CZLandStemCi(XW)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'i'),'c'),'aár'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'i'),'c'),'k'),TrimBackChars(XW,'i'))"
}

# cost: 38
macro = {
	description = "Locative plural ending after an -ové stem: Kipčak -> Kipčacích, Pečeněh -> Pečenězích, Vlach -> Vlaších, Oghuz -> Oghuzech"
	definition = "CZLandLocOve(XS)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZEnds2(XS,'h','c'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XS,'h'),'c'),'ších'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XS,'hg'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XS,'hg'),'zích'),Select_CString(CZEnds(XS,'k'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XS,'k'),'cích'),Concatenate(XS,'ech'))))"
}
# cost: 96
macro = {
	description = "Animate plural genitive: Oghuzové, Polané, Kozáci, Estonci; other -é only after a plural adjective (Bílí Chorvaté)"
	definition = "CZLandAnimPl_G(XW)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'é','v'),Concatenate(CZLandStemOve(XW),'ů'),Select_CString(And(CZEnds2(XW,'é','n'),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'n'),'a')),TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'i','c'),Concatenate(CZLandStemCi(XW),'ů'),Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'i','n'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'i'),'ů'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'ů')))))"
}
# cost: 97
macro = {
	description = "Animate plural dative: Oghuzové, Polané, Kozáci, Estonci; other -é only after a plural adjective (Bílí Chorvaté)"
	definition = "CZLandAnimPl_D(XW)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'é','v'),Concatenate(CZLandStemOve(XW),'ům'),Select_CString(And(CZEnds2(XW,'é','n'),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'n'),'a')),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'ům'),Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'i','c'),Concatenate(CZLandStemCi(XW),'ům'),Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'i','n'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'i'),'ům'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'ům')))))"
}
# cost: 145
macro = {
	description = "Animate plural accusative: Oghuzové, Polané, Kozáci, Estonci; other -é only after a plural adjective (Bílí Chorvaté)"
	definition = "CZLandAnimPl_A(XW)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'é','v'),Concatenate(CZLandStemOve(XW),Select_CString(CZEnds(CZLandStemOve(XW),'jžšřčcď'),'e','y')),Select_CString(And(CZEnds2(XW,'é','n'),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'n'),'a')),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'y'),Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'i','c'),Concatenate(CZLandStemCi(XW),Select_CString(CZEnds(CZLandStemCi(XW),'k'),'y','e')),Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'i','n'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'i'),'y'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'y')))))"
}
# cost: 199
macro = {
	description = "Animate plural locative: Oghuzové, Polané, Kozáci, Estonci; other -é only after a plural adjective (Bílí Chorvaté)"
	definition = "CZLandAnimPl_L(XW)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'é','v'),CZLandLocOve(CZLandStemOve(XW)),Select_CString(And(CZEnds2(XW,'é','n'),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'n'),'a')),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'ech'),Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'i','c'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'i'),'ích'),Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'i','n'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'i'),'ech'),CZLandLocOve(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'))))))"
}
# cost: 145
macro = {
	description = "Animate plural instrumental: Oghuzové, Polané, Kozáci, Estonci; other -é only after a plural adjective (Bílí Chorvaté)"
	definition = "CZLandAnimPl_I(XW)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'é','v'),Concatenate(CZLandStemOve(XW),Select_CString(CZEnds(CZLandStemOve(XW),'jžšřčcď'),'i','y')),Select_CString(And(CZEnds2(XW,'é','n'),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'n'),'a')),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'y'),Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'i','c'),Concatenate(CZLandStemCi(XW),Select_CString(CZEnds(CZLandStemCi(XW),'k'),'y','i')),Select_CString(CZEnds2(XW,'i','n'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'i'),'y'),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'é'),'y')))))"
}
# Two-word peoples: animate plural adjective + people
# (Bordžiginští Mongolové, Osmanští Turci, Lužičtí Srbové).

# cost: 202
macro = {
	description = "True if two-word N is animate plural adjective + people (Bordžiginští Mongolové, Bílí Chorvaté)"
	definition = "CZLandIsAnimPl2(N)"
	replace_with = "And(CZLandIsAdjPl(CZLandW2a(N)),Or(CZLandIsAnimPl(CZLandW2b(N)),CZEnds(CZLandW2b(N),'é')))"
}

# cost: 60
macro = {
	description = "Hard stem of an animate plural adjective: -ští -> -sk, -čtí -> -ck, else drop -í (Bílí -> Bíl)"
	definition = "CZLandAdjPlStem(XW)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(And(CZEnds2(XW,'í','t'),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'í'),'t'),'š')),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'í'),'t'),'š'),'sk'),Select_CString(And(CZEnds2(XW,'í','t'),CZEnds(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'í'),'t'),'č')),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(XW,'í'),'t'),'č'),'ck'),TrimBackChars(XW,'í')))"
}
# cost: 85
macro = {
	description = "Animate plural adjective genitive: Bordžiginští -> Bordžiginských, Západní -> Západních (soft -ní/-ší/-cí/-jí), Černí -> Černých (hard exception)"
	definition = "CZLandAdjPl_G(XW)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(And(CZEnds2(XW,'í','nšcj'),Not(Or(EqualTo_string(XW,'Černí'),EqualTo_string(XW,'černí')))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'í'),'ích'),Concatenate(CZLandAdjPlStem(XW),'ých'))"
}
# cost: 85
macro = {
	description = "Animate plural adjective dative: Bordžiginští -> Bordžiginských, Západní -> Západních (soft -ní/-ší/-cí/-jí), Černí -> Černých (hard exception)"
	definition = "CZLandAdjPl_D(XW)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(And(CZEnds2(XW,'í','nšcj'),Not(Or(EqualTo_string(XW,'Černí'),EqualTo_string(XW,'černí')))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'í'),'ím'),Concatenate(CZLandAdjPlStem(XW),'ým'))"
}

	definition = "CZLandAdjPl_A(XW)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(And(CZEnds2(XW,'í','nšcj'),Not(Or(EqualTo_string(XW,'Černí'),EqualTo_string(XW,'černí')))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(XW,'í'),'í'),Concatenate(CZLandAdjPlStem(XW),'é'))"

	replace_with = "Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(CZLandWord_L(CZLandW3a(N),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3a(N)),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3b(N)),CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3c(N))))),' '),CZLandWord_L(CZLandW3b(N),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3a(N)),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3b(N)),CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3c(N)))))),' '),CZLandWord_L(CZLandW3c(N),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3a(N)),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3b(N)),CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3c(N))))))"
}
# cost: 874
macro = {
	description = "Czech one-word landed title name instrumental"
	definition = "CZLandCase1_I(N)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZLandIsAnimPl(N),CZLandAnimPl_I(N),CZLandWord_I(N,CZLandIsFemNoun(N)))"
}

# cost: 4017
macro = {
	description = "Czech two-word landed title name instrumental"
	definition = "CZLandCase2_I(N)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZLandIsAnimPl2(N),Concatenate(Concatenate(CZLandAdjPl_I(CZLandW2a(N)),' '),CZLandAnimPl_I(CZLandW2b(N))),Concatenate(Concatenate(CZLandWord_I(CZLandW2a(N),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW2a(N)),CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW2b(N)))),' '),CZLandWord_I(CZLandW2b(N),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW2a(N)),CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW2b(N))))))"
}

# cost: 9553
macro = {
	description = "Czech three-word landed title name instrumental"
	definition = "CZLandCase3_I(N)"
	replace_with = "Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(CZLandWord_I(CZLandW3a(N),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3a(N)),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3b(N)),CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3c(N))))),' '),CZLandWord_I(CZLandW3b(N),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3a(N)),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3b(N)),CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3c(N)))))),' '),CZLandWord_I(CZLandW3c(N),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3a(N)),Or(CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3b(N)),CZLandIsFemWord(CZLandW3c(N))))))"
}
# ------------------------------------------------
# DISPATCH (CustomLoc key selection)
# ------------------------------------------------
# Select_CString evaluates both branches, so every branch below is a
# separate CustomLoc key and only the key returned here is evaluated
# through ROOT.GetLandedTitle.Custom(<key>). Keys: 99_cz_custom_loc.txt.

# cost: 6
macro = {
	description = "Table key CZ_LT_<title key>_<case>"
	definition = "CZLandKey(XT,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate('CZ_LT_',XT.GetKey),'_'),XCASE)"
}

# cost: 32
macro = {
	description = "True if the title still has its default name and the table has an entry for XCASE (Localize of a missing key returns the key)"
	definition = "CZLandHasEntry(XT,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "And(EqualTo_string(XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip,Localize(XT.GetKey)),And(Not(StringIsEmpty(Localize(CZLandKey(XT,XCASE)))),Not(EqualTo_string(Localize(CZLandKey(XT,XCASE)),CZLandKey(XT,XCASE)))))"
}

# cost: 21
macro = {
	description = "True if the title name has the form '<Tier> <Name>'"
	definition = "CZLandIsTiered(XT)"
	replace_with = "EqualTo_string(XT.GetNameNoTooltip,CZJoin(XT.GetTierAsNameNoTooltip,XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip))"
}

# cost: 21
macro = {
	description = "Composer key PFX<1|2|3>_<case> by word count of N"
	definition = "CZLandLenKey(N,PFX,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "Concatenate(Concatenate(PFX,Select_CString(CZTitleHasThird(N),'3_',Select_CString(CZTitleHasSecond(N),'2_','1_'))),XCASE)"
}

# cost: 4
macro = {
	description = "N without its first word: Rod Li -> Li"
	definition = "CZLandRest(N)"
	replace_with = "TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(N,Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))"
}

# cost: 14
macro = {
	description = "True if N is 'Rod <name>': only Rod is declined, the name stays (z Rodu Li)"
	definition = "CZLandIsRod(N)"
	replace_with = "And(CZTitleHasSecond(N),EqualTo_string(Concatenate('Rod ',CZLandRest(N)),N))"
}

# cost: 4229
macro = {
	description = "Key for the name without tier: table, Rod <name>, rule composer, or unchanged"
	definition = "CZLandNoTierKey(XT,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZLandHasEntry(XT,XCASE),Concatenate('CZ_LandTable_',XCASE),Select_CString(CZLandIsRod(XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip),Concatenate('CZ_LandRod_',XCASE),Select_CString(Or(And(Not(CZTitleHasSecond(XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip)),CZLandIsAnimPl(XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip)),Or(And(CZTitleHasSecond(XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip),And(Not(CZTitleHasThird(XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip)),CZLandIsAnimPl2(XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip))),And(Not(CZTitleHasFourth(XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip)),CZLandOneNoun(CZTitleWord1(XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip),CZTitleWord2(XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip),CZTitleWord3(XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip))))),CZLandLenKey(XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip,'CZ_LandNoTier',XCASE),'CZ_LandRawNoTier')))"
}

# Staged NoTier dispatch. Stage 1 only checks table / Rod and word count, so
# table hits never pay for the morphology conditions (Select is eager).
# Stage 2 (CZ_LandNTMorph<n>_<case>) checks morphology for an exact word count.

# cost: 77
macro = {
	description = "Stage 1 NoTier key: table, Rod or CZ_LandNTMorph<n>_<case>"
	definition = "CZLandNoTierStage1(XT,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZLandHasEntry(XT,XCASE),Concatenate('CZ_LandTable_',XCASE),Select_CString(CZLandIsRod(XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip),Concatenate('CZ_LandRod_',XCASE),CZLandLenKey(XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip,'CZ_LandNTMorph',XCASE)))"
}

# Fast table-only form for names rendered many times per frame (mercenary
# companies, holy orders in the army window): no Custom dispatch, no Rod or
# morphology; untabled or renamed titles stay in the nominative.

# cost: 42
macro = {
	description = "Table-only NoTier name of title XT in case XCASE, nominative if not in the table"
	definition = "CZLandFast(XT,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZLandHasEntry(XT,XCASE),Localize(CZLandKey(XT,XCASE)),XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip)"
}

# cost: 458
macro = {
	description = "Stage 2 NoTier key for a one-word name N"
	definition = "CZLandNTMorph1Key(N,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(Or(CZLandIsAnimPl(N),CZLandOneNoun(N,'','')),Concatenate('CZ_LandNoTier1_',XCASE),'CZ_LandRawNoTier')"
}

# cost: 876
macro = {
	description = "Stage 2 NoTier key for a two-word name N"
	definition = "CZLandNTMorph2Key(N,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(Or(CZLandIsAnimPl2(N),CZLandOneNoun(CZLandW2a(N),CZLandW2b(N),'')),Concatenate('CZ_LandNoTier2_',XCASE),'CZ_LandRawNoTier')"
}

# cost: 1246
macro = {
	description = "Stage 2 NoTier key for a name N with three or more words"
	definition = "CZLandNTMorph3Key(N,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(And(Not(CZTitleHasFourth(N)),CZLandOneNoun(CZLandW3a(N),CZLandW3b(N),CZLandW3c(N))),Concatenate('CZ_LandNoTier3_',XCASE),'CZ_LandRawNoTier')"
}

# cost: 32
macro = {
	description = "Key for the full name: declined tier + name, untiered name, or unchanged"
	definition = "CZLandFullKey(XT,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZLandIsTiered(XT),Concatenate('CZ_LandTierPart_',XCASE),Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XT.GetNameNoTooltip,XT.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip),Concatenate('CZ_LandedNameNoTierNoTooltip_',XCASE),'CZ_LandRawName'))"
}

# Same idea as CZAdjectiveDeclineRich (Faith / Religion): keep the native
# rich getter, which carries a working tooltip/onclick, and only replace its
# visible tail. The plain name XP has 1-6 words, so exactly that many
# words are cut from the end of the native string (after its closers).
# The result is verified: prefix + XP + closers must equal the native
# string, otherwise the declined plain text is returned without tooltip.

# cost: 3
macro = {
	description = "Native rich title string without its trailing closers"
	definition = "CZLandRichBody(XR)"
	replace_with = "TrimBackChars(XR,Localize('CZ_FMT_CLOSE_CHARS'))"
}

# cost: 140
macro = {
	description = "Rich prefix (formatting before the visible name) of native string XR whose plain text is XP"
	definition = "CZLandRichPrefix(XR,XP)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(Not(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(XP, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))))),TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(CZLandRichBody(XR), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')),Select_CString(Not(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(XP, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))))),TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(CZLandRichBody(XR), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')),Select_CString(Not(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(XP, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))))),TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(CZLandRichBody(XR), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')),Select_CString(Not(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(XP, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))))),TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(CZLandRichBody(XR), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')),Select_CString(Not(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(XP, Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))))),TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(CZLandRichBody(XR), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')),TrimBackChars(CZLandRichBody(XR), Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))))))"
}

# cost: 18
macro = {
	description = "Closers of native rich string XR (2 or 3 levels) after its body, or empty; does not check the prefix (see CZLandRichOK)"
	definition = "CZLandRichClose(XR,XP)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XR,Concatenate(CZLandRichBody(XR),Localize('CZ_FMT_CLOSE2'))),Localize('CZ_FMT_CLOSE2'),Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XR,Concatenate(CZLandRichBody(XR),Localize('CZ_FMT_CLOSE3'))),Localize('CZ_FMT_CLOSE3'),''))"
}

# cost: 167
macro = {
	description = "True if native rich string XR is prefix + XP + 2 or 3 closers"
	definition = "CZLandRichOK(XR,XP)"
	replace_with = "And(EqualTo_string(Concatenate(CZLandRichPrefix(XR,XP),XP),CZLandRichBody(XR)),Not(StringIsEmpty(CZLandRichClose(XR,XP))))"
}

# cost: 330
macro = {
	description = "Put declined text XD into the native rich string XR (plain text XP); plain XD if XR cannot be decomposed. Prefix is evaluated twice (was five times)"
	definition = "CZLandRich(XR,XP,XD)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZLandRichOK(XR,XP),Concatenate(Concatenate(CZLandRichPrefix(XR,XP),XD),CZLandRichClose(XR,XP)),XD)"
}

# Choose the vocalized form of a preposition for the following word.
# XTXT must be plain text (NoTooltip getter); declension does not change
# the first letters, so the nominative can be passed:
#   [CZPrepV(TITLE.GetNameNoTierNoTooltip)] [TITLE.Custom('CZ_LandedNameNoTier_L')]
# Use |U for sentence start: [CZPrepZ(...)|U]

# cost: 6
macro = {
	description = "True if XTXT starts with any of the characters in XC"
	definition = "CZStartsWith(XTXT,XC)"
	replace_with = "Not(EqualTo_string(XTXT,TrimFrontChars(XTXT,XC)))"
}

# cost: 6
macro = {
	description = "Preposition z/ze: ze before s/z/š/ž: ze Švédska, z Polska"
	definition = "CZPrepZ(XTXT)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZStartsWith(XTXT,'sSzZšŠžŽ'),'ze','z')"
}

# cost: 6
macro = {
	description = "Preposition s/se: se before s/z/š/ž: se Saskem, s Polskem"
	definition = "CZPrepS(XTXT)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZStartsWith(XTXT,'sSzZšŠžŽ'),'se','s')"
}

# cost: 20
macro = {
	description = "Preposition k/ke: ke before k/g and s/z/š/ž + consonant: ke Kastilii, ke Skotsku, k Polsku"
	definition = "CZPrepK(XTXT)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(Or(CZStartsWith(XTXT,'kKgG'),And(CZStartsWith(XTXT,'sSzZšŠžŽ'),CZStartsWith(TrimFrontChars(XTXT,'sSzZšŠžŽ'),'bBcCčČdDďĎfFgGhHjJkKlLmMnNňŇpPqQrRřŘsSšŠtTťŤvVwWxXzZžŽ'))),'ke','k')"
}

# cost: 20
macro = {
	description = "Preposition v/ve: ve before v/f/w and s/z/š/ž/č/ř + consonant: ve Francii, ve Švédsku, v Čechách"
	definition = "CZPrepV(XTXT)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(Or(CZStartsWith(XTXT,'vVfFwW'),And(CZStartsWith(XTXT,'sSzZšŠžŽčČřŘ'),CZStartsWith(TrimFrontChars(XTXT,'sSzZšŠžŽčČřŘ'),'bBcCčČdDďĎfFgGhHjJkKlLmMnNňŇpPqQrRřŘsSšŠtTťŤvVwWxXzZžŽ'))),'ve','v')"
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# TEXT-ONLY GENITIVE (character names "z <title>")
# ------------------------------------------------
# The CHARACTER_NAME / CHARACTER_FULL_NAME family only gets $TITLE$ as text
# (no CHARACTER or title scope there), so the genitive is built from text:
#   "$TIER$ $NAME$ [CZPrepZ('$TITLE|q$')] [CZLandTextG('$TITLE|q$')]"
# 1. text table: genitives of CZ_LT_*_G entries, matched by nominative text
#    (generated from 00_cz_landed_title_cases_l_polish.yml, chunks of 10
#    to stay under the nesting limit)
# 2. otherwise the same rules as for titles (guard + 1-3 word composers)

# cost: 30
macro = {
	description = "Text table genitive, part 1 (empty if no match): Antverpy, Athény, Atény, Baleáry, Benátky, Bruggy, Brémy, Cáchy, Damašek, Domažlice"
	definition = "CZLandTextTable0(XTTL)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Antverpy'),'Antverp',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Athény'),'Athén',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Atény'),'Atén',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Baleáry'),'Baleár',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Benátky'),'Benátek',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Bruggy'),'Brugg',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Brémy'),'Brém',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Cáchy'),'Cách',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Damašek'),'Damašku',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Domažlice'),'Domažlic',''))))))))))"
}

# cost: 30
macro = {
	description = "Text table genitive, part 2 (empty if no match): Doudleby, Drážďany, Egejské ostrovy, Faerské ostrovy, Flandry, Franky, Hebridy, Jasy, Jeruzalém, Kanárské ostrovy"
	definition = "CZLandTextTable1(XTTL)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Doudleby'),'Doudleb',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Drážďany'),'Drážďan',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Egejské ostrovy'),'Egejských ostrovů',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Faerské ostrovy'),'Faerských ostrovů',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Flandry'),'Flander',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Franky'),'Frank',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Hebridy'),'Hebrid',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Jasy'),'Jas',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Jeruzalém'),'Jeruzaléma',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Kanárské ostrovy'),'Kanárských ostrovů',''))))))))))"
}

# cost: 30
macro = {
	description = "Text table genitive, part 3 (empty if no match): Korutany, Kyjevská Rus, Litoměřice, Lofoty, Maledivy, Mazury, Moluky, Mugodžarské hory, Novogrudek, Rodopy"
	definition = "CZLandTextTable2(XTTL)"

# cost: 30
macro = {
	description = "Text table genitive, part 4 (empty if no match): Severní ostrovy, Shetlandy, Syrakusy, Súsy, Transylvánské Alpy, Vasjuganské bažiny, Vnitřní Hebridy, Vnější Hebridy, Východní Franky, Západní Franky"

# cost: 12
macro = {

	definition = "CZLandTextTable4(XTTL)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Ålandy'),'Åland',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Čechy'),'Čech',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Čerkasy'),'Čerkas',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTTL,'Hradec Králové'),'Hradce Králové',''))))"
}

# Kept flat on purpose: the game aborts with "Macro argument replacement
# exceeded depth 20" when macros are chained too deeply (a chain of table
# macros ending in the rules failed). Table parts are siblings joined by
# Concatenate and the rules are inlined here.

# cost: 18323
macro = {
	description = "Genitive of a plain title name text: Rod <name>, text table, then rules"
	definition = "CZLandTextG(XTTL)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZLandIsRod(XTTL),Concatenate('Rodu ',CZLandRest(XTTL)),Select_CString(StringIsEmpty(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(CZLandTextTable0(XTTL),CZLandTextTable1(XTTL)),CZLandTextTable2(XTTL)),CZLandTextTable3(XTTL)),CZLandTextTable4(XTTL))),Select_CString(Or(And(Not(CZTitleHasSecond(XTTL)),CZLandIsAnimPl(XTTL)),Or(And(CZTitleHasSecond(XTTL),And(Not(CZTitleHasThird(XTTL)),CZLandIsAnimPl2(XTTL))),And(Not(CZTitleHasFourth(XTTL)),CZLandOneNoun(CZTitleWord1(XTTL),CZTitleWord2(XTTL),CZTitleWord3(XTTL))))),Select_CString(CZTitleHasThird(XTTL),CZLandCase3_G(XTTL),Select_CString(CZTitleHasSecond(XTTL),CZLandCase2_G(XTTL),CZLandCase1_G(XTTL))),XTTL),Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(CZLandTextTable0(XTTL),CZLandTextTable1(XTTL)),CZLandTextTable2(XTTL)),CZLandTextTable3(XTTL)),CZLandTextTable4(XTTL))))"
}



# Fast text genitive for names rendered many times per frame (the
# CHARACTER_NAME family): one Localize() of the generated text table
# CZ_TG_<nominative> (00_cz_title_text_genitive*_l_polish, gen_text_genitive.py)
# instead of the full rules; names not in the table stay in the nominative.
# Loc keys cannot contain spaces, so they are written as '_' (1-3 words;
# 4+ words keep a space in the key and never match).

# cost: 51
macro = {
	description = "Name XTTL with spaces as _ (1-3 words) for text-keyed tables"
	definition = "CZUnderscore(XTTL)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(XTTL,Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))),XTTL,Select_CString(StringIsEmpty(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(XTTL,Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))),Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))),Concatenate(Concatenate(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(XTTL,Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))),'_'),TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(XTTL,Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))),Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimBack(TrimBackChars(XTTL,Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))),Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))),'_'),TrimBack(TrimBackChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(XTTL,Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))),Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars')))),'_'),TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(XTTL,Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))),Localize('CZ_TitleTokenChars'))))))"
}

# cost: 52
macro = {
	description = "Text table key CZ_TG_<name with spaces as _> for a 1-3 word name"
	definition = "CZTextKey(XTTL)"
	replace_with = "Concatenate('CZ_TG_',CZUnderscore(XTTL))"
}

# cost: 181
macro = {
	description = "Genitive of a plain title name text: Rod <name>, then the text table, else unchanged"
	definition = "CZLandTextFastG(XTTL)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(CZLandIsRod(XTTL),Concatenate('Rodu ',CZLandRest(XTTL)),Select_CString(EqualTo_string(Localize(CZTextKey(XTTL)),CZTextKey(XTTL)),XTTL,Localize(CZTextKey(XTTL))))"
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# ACTIVITY TYPES
# ------------------------------------------------
# Hand-written case table (gen_activity_cases.py): CZ_ACT_<type>_<case>,
# cases G D A L I; nominative = native GetName.
#   [CZActivity('activity_hunt','G')]           rich, keeps tooltip
#   [CZActivityNoTooltip('activity_hunt','L')]  plain
#   [CZActivityText(X.GetNameNoTooltip,'A')]    dynamic ActivityType, by name;
#                                               unknown names stay nominative

# cost: 404
macro = {
	description = "Activity type XKEY in case XCASE with the native tooltip"
	definition = "CZActivity(XKEY,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "CZLandRich(GetActivityType(XKEY).GetName,GetActivityType(XKEY).GetNameNoTooltip,Localize(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate('CZ_ACT_',XKEY),'_'),XCASE)))"
}

# cost: 6
macro = {
	description = "Activity type XKEY in case XCASE, plain text"
	definition = "CZActivityNoTooltip(XKEY,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "Localize(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate('CZ_ACT_',XKEY),'_'),XCASE))"
}

# cost: 170
macro = {
	description = "Activity type name text XN in case XCASE (text table CZ_ACTX_), else unchanged"
	definition = "CZActivityText(XN,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(EqualTo_string(Localize(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate('CZ_ACTX_',XCASE),'_'),CZUnderscore(XN))),Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate('CZ_ACTX_',XCASE),'_'),CZUnderscore(XN))),XN,Localize(Concatenate(Concatenate(Concatenate('CZ_ACTX_',XCASE),'_'),CZUnderscore(XN))))"
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# TIER EXCEPTIONS
# ------------------------------------------------
# One-word tier names the rules get wrong. Empty string = no exception.

# cost: 12
macro = {
	description = "Irregular one-word tier name, case G (Klášter, Kmen, Městys, Osady); empty if none"
	definition = "CZLandTierExc_G(XTIER)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTIER,'Klášter'),'Kláštera',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTIER,'Kmen'),'Kmene',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTIER,'Městys'),'Městyse',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTIER,'Osady'),'Osad',''))))"
}

# cost: 12
macro = {
	description = "Irregular one-word tier name, case D (Klášter, Kmen, Městys, Osady); empty if none"
	definition = "CZLandTierExc_D(XTIER)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTIER,'Klášter'),'Klášteru',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTIER,'Kmen'),'Kmeni',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTIER,'Městys'),'Městysi',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(XTIER,'Osady'),'Osadám',''))))"
}

# cost: 12
macro = {
	description = "Irregular one-word tier name, case A (Klášter, Kmen, Městys, Osady); empty if none"

}

# ------------------------------------------------
# PROVINCES
# ------------------------------------------------
# A province has no Custom() of its own; its name is the name of its
# barony, so the barony title is declined. The rich variant keeps the
# native province string (province tooltip + onclick).
#   v [PROVINCE.GetName] -> [CZPrepV(PROVINCE.GetNameNoTooltip)] [CZProvName(PROVINCE,'L')]

# cost: 29272 worst / 5094 mean
macro = {
	description = "Declined province name with the native tooltip (XCASE = 'G' 'D' 'A' 'L' 'I')"
	definition = "CZProvName(P,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "CZLandRich(P.GetName,P.GetNameNoTooltip,P.GetTitle.Custom(Concatenate('CZ_LandedNameNoTierNoTooltip_',XCASE)))"
}

# cost: 14456 worst / 2367 mean
macro = {
	description = "Declined province name, plain text (XCASE = 'G' 'D' 'A' 'L' 'I')"
	definition = "CZProvNameNoTooltip(P,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "P.GetTitle.Custom(Concatenate('CZ_LandedNameNoTierNoTooltip_',XCASE))"
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# TERRAIN
# ------------------------------------------------
# Terrain has no Custom() of its own; it is dispatched on the province's
# barony title (CZ_Terrain_* in 99_cz_custom_loc.txt). Plain text only,
# replaces P.GetTerrain.GetNameNoTooltip. Capitalized like the native
# name, so keep |l where the original had it. CZTerrainIn already
# includes the preposition and is lowercase.
#   v [PROVINCE.GetTerrain.GetNameNoTooltip|l] -> [CZTerrainIn(PROVINCE)]

# cost: 41 worst / 23 mean
macro = {
	description = "Declined terrain name of a province, plain text (XCASE = 'G' 'D' 'A' 'L' 'I')"
	definition = "CZTerrain(P,XCASE)"
	replace_with = "P.GetTitle.Custom(Concatenate('CZ_Terrain_',XCASE))"
}

# cost: 39 worst / 21 mean
macro = {
	description = "Terrain of a province in locative with its preposition (na pláních, v horách, ve stepi)"
	definition = "CZTerrainIn(P)"
	replace_with = "P.GetTitle.Custom('CZ_TerrainIn')"
}

# Variant for a bare Terrain object with no province behind it
# (RegimentTerrainModifier.GetTerrain). Matches the Czech nominative from
# terrains_l_polish.yml, so it must be kept in sync with that file and
# with CZ_TerrainIn_*. Prefer CZTerrainIn(P) whenever a province exists.

# cost: 63
macro = {
	description = "Locative with preposition for a Terrain object, by name match (v horách, na pláních)"
	definition = "CZTerrainObjIn(T)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Pláně'),'na pláních',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Obdělávaná půda'),'na obdělávané půdě',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Kopce'),'v kopcích',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Hory'),'v horách',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Poušť'),'v poušti',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Pouštní hory'),'v pouštních horách',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Oáza'),'v oáze',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Džungle'),'v džungli',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Les'),'v lese',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Tajga'),'v tajze',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Mokřady'),'v mokřadech',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Step'),'ve stepi',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Záplavové nížiny'),'v záplavových nížinách',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Suchá krajina'),'v suché krajině',Select_CString(EqualTo_string(T.GetNameNoTooltip,'Terasovité kopce'),'v terasovitých kopcích',Concatenate('v ',T.GetNameNoTooltip))))))))))))))))"
}

##################################################
# CHARACTER GETTER ADAPTERS - ADDITIVE EXTENSION
##################################################
# TrimFrontChars is a character-set operation, never substring deletion.
# Validate exact reconstruction before replacing. Keep older helpers intact.
# cost: 42
macro = {
    description = "Exact prefix accepting either consumed or retained suffix whitespace"
    definition = "CZHasNamePrefixPreservingSpace(TEXT,PREFIX)"
    replace_with = "Or(CZHasNamePrefix(TEXT,PREFIX),And(Not(StringIsEmpty(PREFIX)),And(EqualTo_string(TEXT,Concatenate(PREFIX,TrimFrontChars(TEXT,PREFIX))),Or(EqualTo_string(TEXT,PREFIX),Not(EqualTo_string(TrimFrontChars(TEXT,PREFIX),TrimFront(TrimFrontChars(TEXT,PREFIX))))))))"
}
# cost: 102
macro = {
    description = "Replace a verified name prefix retaining its suffix separator"
    definition = "CZReplaceNamePrefixPreservingSpace(TEXT,PREFIX,REPLACEMENT)"
    replace_with = "Select_CString(CZHasNamePrefix(TEXT,PREFIX),CZReplaceNamePrefix(TEXT,PREFIX,REPLACEMENT),Select_CString(CZHasNamePrefixPreservingSpace(TEXT,PREFIX),Concatenate(REPLACEMENT,TrimFrontChars(TEXT,PREFIX)),TEXT))"
}
# cost: 8
macro = {
    description = "Non-empty single name token; alphabet is additive and does not change the old title tokenizer"
    definition = "CZNameIsSingleToken(NAME)"
    replace_with = "And(Not(StringIsEmpty(NAME)),StringIsEmpty(TrimFrontChars(NAME,Localize('CZ_AdapterNameTokenChars'))))"
}

# cost: 47
macro = {
	description = "Existing possessive rules, noun M, owner female, explicit name input"
	definition = "CZNamePossessive_M_F(NAME)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(NAME,TrimBackChars(NAME,'a'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(NAME,'a'),'in'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(NAME,TrimBackChars(NAME,'e'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(NAME,'e'),'in'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(NAME,TrimBackChars(NAME,'ií'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(NAME,'ií'),'in'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(NAME,TrimBackChars(NAME,'o'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(NAME,'o'),'in'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(NAME,TrimBackChars(NAME,'uú'))),Concatenate(TrimBackChars(NAME,'uú'),'in'),Concatenate(NAME,'in'))))))"
}

# cost: 44
macro = {
	description = "Existing possessive rules, noun M, owner male, explicit name input"
	definition = "CZNamePossessive_M_M(NAME)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(NAME,TrimBackChars(NAME,'a'))),Concatenate(CZFirstNameStem_M_A(NAME),'ův'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(NAME,TrimBackChars(NAME,'o'))),Concatenate(CZFirstNameStem_M_O(NAME),'ův'),Select_CString(And(Not(EqualTo_string(NAME,TrimBackChars(NAME,'e'))),Not(EqualTo_string(TrimBackChars(NAME,'e'),TrimBackChars(TrimBackChars(NAME,'e'),'i')))),Concatenate(NAME,'ho'),Select_CString(Not(EqualTo_string(NAME,TrimBackChars(NAME,'iíyé'))),Concatenate(NAME,'ho'),Concatenate(NAME,'ův')))))"
}

macro = {
	description = "Existing possessive rules, noun M, owner gender dispatch"
	definition = "CZNamePossessive_M(NAME,IS_FEMALE)"
	replace_with = "Select_CString(IS_FEMALE,CZNamePossessive_M_F(NAME),CZNamePossessive_M_M(NAME))"
}
